name: Clerk Pro for GitHub Students
benefit: Clerk Pro-tier authentication and user management allowance at no charge for a verified GitHub student on one Clerk workspace, with the normal Pro usage limits.
eligibility: GitHub Student Developer Pack verified students who keep the qualifying GitHub account connected to Clerk.
duration: Valid during verified GitHub student tenure; benefits cease when student eligibility or the GitHub account connection ends.
restrictions: One workspace per verified student; SMS authentication is excluded and may require a separate paid upgrade. Graduates lose student benefits and revert to Hobby; extra services and charges must be checked before upgrading.
